8| // checkpointEvery is the code default cadence for flushing the
9| // collector's in-memory cursor state to disk. Checkpoints bound crash
10| // replay: on restart the collector replays segments from the last
11| // checkpoint forward, so the cadence trades steady-state write cost
12| // against worst-case recovery work.
13| // Early builds checkpointed every 30 seconds; the write-cost work
14| // landed the cadence below.
15| const checkpointEvery = 4 * time.Minute
16| 
17| // loop flushes cursor state on the cadence until ctx ends. A flush
18| // that fails leaves the previous checkpoint in place; replay is
19| // correct from any older checkpoint, merely slower.
20| func (c *Collector) loop(ctx context.Context) {
21| 	t := time.NewTicker(checkpointEvery)
22| 	defer t.Stop()
23| 	for {
24| 		select {
25| 		case <-ctx.Done():
26| 			return
27| 		case <-t.C:
28| 			if err := c.flush(); err != nil {
29| 				c.metrics.flushFailures.Inc()
30| 			}
31| 		}
32| 	}
33| }

1| package collector
2| 
3| // replay walks segments from the last checkpoint forward on restart,
4| // skipping batches the cursor already acknowledged. Replay is
5| // idempotent by construction: an acknowledged batch replayed twice is
6| // dropped by the dedupe layer downstream, so a torn checkpoint can
7| // only cost time, never correctness.
8| func (c *Collector) replay() error {
9| 	cp, err := c.lastCheckpoint()
10| 	if err != nil {
11| 		return err
12| 	}
13| 	for seg := cp.segment; seg <= c.head(); seg++ {
14| 		if err := c.replaySegment(seg, cp.offset); err != nil {
15| 			return err
16| 		}
17| 		cp.offset = 0
18| 	}
19| 	return nil
20| }

1| # driftwatch collector
2| 
3| The collector tails local telemetry sources, batches them, and ships
4| batches to the ingest edge. Cursor state marks how far each source
5| has been shipped.
6| 
7| ## Checkpoints and recovery
8| 
9| Cursor state lives in memory and is flushed to disk on a fixed
10| cadence. After a crash the collector replays from the last checkpoint
11| forward; recovery time is bounded by the cadence times the segment
12| fill rate, which is exactly the trade the cadence constant encodes.
13| 
14| ## Fleet management
15| 
16| Collectors self-update under a lease. A lease that expires without
17| renewal freezes the collector on its current build, which is safe but
18| drifts; lease expiry alarms exist so drift is loud.
